summary: Learn OKR implementation and performance alignment with practical tools, dashboards, and rollout methods. Enrol to build aligned goals that drive execution.
lede: OKR implementation training helps managers and strategy teams connect organizational goals to measurable outcomes and monitor execution. Participants learn to draft measurable Objectives and Key Results, align priorities across functions, and build scorecards with check-in rhythms and scoring rules. The course also covers performance reporting and rollout planning, making ownership and progress visible through a repeatable review cycle.
audienceIntro: This course is for you if you already manage goals, reports, or team delivery and need a practical way to align performance with strategy.
modules: Writing OKRs with the PMBOK-style discipline
OKR alignment across teams and functions
OKR review, reporting, and next-cycle planning
prerequisites: You will need a laptop, spreadsheet software, and access to simple performance data from a team, function, or business unit. A basic understanding of organisational planning, goal setting, and reporting cycles is expected.
